data.name: Feral Hunter
data.description: A feral hunter has forged a bond with nature that's so strong that she doesn't merely channel the aspects of animals-she actually becomes an animal herself. Though she lacks an animal companion, a feral hunter is in tune with the beast lurking within her flesh and spirit, and lives in a near-wild state of being. A feral hunter often resembles a lycanthrope, but her power comes from her own nature and is not influenced by moonlight or silver.
